name: prompt-enhancer
description: Enhance Prompt: a button under the prompt that rewrites what you typed, in place, with the files, memories, conversation and skills the task needs. Nothing is sent until you press Enter.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to hide the Enhance Prompt button and stop the command rewriting prompts.

model.title: Model
model.description: Which model rewrites your prompt: haiku is fast and cheap, or session uses this session's model. Default: haiku.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks while rewriting. Default lets the model decide; session follows this session's effort.

hindsightSeconds.title: Hindsight time limit (seconds)
hindsightSeconds.description: How long to wait for the Hindsight memory server before rewriting without it, from 1 to 60. Default: 5 seconds.

soulBank.title: About-you memory bank
soulBank.description: Name of the Hindsight bank holding facts about you, shared with Self Improve. Default: soul.

skillFolders.title: Extra skill folders
skillFolders.description: More folders of skills to offer, each skill a folder with a SKILL.md; separate folders with commas or semicolons. Default: empty, so only the usual places are searched.

maxSkills.title: Skills offered
maxSkills.description: The most skills listed to the model, those matching your prompt first, from 1 to 60. Default: 60.

conversationMessages.title: Recent messages shown
conversationMessages.description: How many recent conversation messages the model sees, from 1 to 20. Default: 8.
